entries.title: Subnautica

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulator route is needed.

primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity, most configurable route for the complete original game, with PC settings/mod support and the cleanest capture path. Later console, mobile, and Switch 2 versions are useful access routes but do not add exclusive story content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows build through Steam/Epic/Microsoft Store with high settings; use PC mods only if they are wanted for capture or quality-of-life, not as required story content.

entries.title: Subnautica 2
entries.definitive_edition: No definitive edition yet; Early Access/Game Preview

emulation.notes: Use the official native PC Early Access build; no emulator route is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output, subject to Early Access optimization and content changes.

primary.why: The current release is Early Access/Game Preview, and Windows is the highest-fidelity, most configurable route. Xbox Series X/S is a valid Game Preview route but does not add exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the official Windows Early Access build through Steam/Epic/Microsoft Store or PC Game Pass, understanding that the game is not final and may change before 1.0.

all_releases.fidelity: Early Access PC release with Steam/Epic/Microsoft Store routes and configurable graphics.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity current route, though the game is still unfinished Early Access.

all_releases.fidelity: Xbox Game Preview release.
all_releases.reason: skip: valid console/Game Pass route, but no content advantage over Windows and less configurable for archive capture.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The platform choice is clear for current fidelity, but the game itself is Early Access/Game Preview; no platform is a final complete 1.0 route yet.

entries.remaster_caveats: Because this is an unfinished Early Access/Game Preview release, revisit the entry when 1.0 or additional platform releases arrive.
